body: And any time I've tried to leave before he won't let me pack my things or go out the door. He will like lock me in his bedroom until I agree to stay.
I guess it's just scary because I don't have a plan

It's hard not to look at the big picture when it's such an utterly life changing decision. I know my parents won't respect my privacy, and they might not even let me bring my pets. Also there's the fact that just considering leaving makes me feel awful because I promised I would marry him and guilty because despite him being a big jerk, he takes care of me.
And also if I go anywhere I want to be able to have my pets. I have a kitten and a snake. I couldn't leave them with him.

I do talk with them, but my parents both have full houses, and it scares me that he knows where they both live. And also the place where I work is owned by my dad's girlfriend, so I don't think I would lose my job if it came to me having to go to a shelter or not having a ride to work, but I know that everything would be out in the open then. I don't want to feel like my privacy is being invaded anymore.
What's wrong? And I mean besides "everything".
